statements.impact_statement: Reviewed by Codex on 2026-10-03 for PR #491: http-cache-semantics 4.2.0 is a development-only desktop dependency through electron-builder / @electron/get / got / cacheable-request, and an Astro 7.3.2 dependency used for static-image build processing. Blanc does not expose the shared-cache satisfiesWithoutRevalidation path to user-controlled max-stale directives: desktop build downloads are clients rather than a multi-user cache service, got caching is not configured, and Astro constructs image requests without visitor headers and uses storable/timeToLive rather than the affected stale-reuse method. The package is absent from the desktop runtime, Worker and companion graphs; the deployed site is static and carries no Astro server. Evidence, automated boundary guards and re-review conditions: docs/security-reviews/2026-10-03-http-cache-semantics.md. This disposition does not cover server-side Astro deployment, a shared/proxy cache, newly configured got caching or new first-party/runtime consumers.

Reviewed by Codex on 2026-10-02: node-forge 1.4.0 occurs only under development-only web-ext 10.6.0 / @devicefarmer/adbkit 3.3.9 in the tab-import companion lockfile. adbkit contains affected RSA verification in its TCP/USB authentication server, but Blanc's lint, build, and sign commands never load the Android runner or start that server. These dependencies are absent from the desktop dependency graph and companion archive. Evidence and re-review conditions: docs/security-reviews/2026-10-02-node-forge.md. This does not cover direct adbkit use or web-ext's Android run target.

The affected image-size parser is reachable only through web-ext while maintainers lint or package committed companion-extension files. Blanc does not pass network, user, or release-time input to this parser.

The affected adm-zip extraction is a development-only web-ext path operating on committed companion-extension sources and a maintainer-selected local output directory. It is absent from Blanc release payloads and receives no untrusted archive or destination path.
